usedFor: Evenium holds the events and guests, HubSpot receives them as contacts, and “New Guests Added” can start “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Guests Added” in Evenium, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new guest becomes a HubSpot contact, and the action returns the created contact record.

watchOut: “Create Contact” in HubSpot requires an email, so a guest from “New Guests Added” without one cannot become a contact.
